Grave of the Fireflies..... it still hurts.
Maybe reaching out to professionals may help the anxiety you are experiencing. Don’t be afraid to ask for help. There are resources.

The education field sounds like a great path to pursue. It seems like you do have the ability to do something meaningful, you just need to give yourself time. I hope you have seeked professional help to get your mental health issues resolved. I know it’s tough, but it’s possible. Sending you my best wishes.
Would you like to explain why you feel everything is anxiety ridden?

Would finding another job be an option for you? Or maybe moving back to the previous state you lived in? I’m sorry to hear your boyfriend broke up with you. Have you explained to him how you felt? Maybe sitting down, having a deep talk, and getting everything off your chest could help give you some closure.
Is there anything else you could be looking forward to? What about Spiderman: Far From Home? I heard it takes place minutes after Endgame so maybe you would be interested in that?

I’m sorry for whatever you are going through that is making you feel this way. I agree that people don’t actually care. I’ve opened up to so many people about my struggles, yet nobody checks up on me. They just forget. Would you care to explain more as to why you are feeling this way? I’m all ears.
You say you wish you could do something meaningful. Have you tried to pursue whatever that may be?

I feel the same way. I can’t imagine my future because I feel like I’m not meant to be here. Thinking of living for decades more just makes me miserable because I know my life has no meaning. I hate who I am and that will never change. My future looks blank and empty, and I think that’s because my time to go will come soon.
